name: Laundry tetris
summary: A time puzzle in the dorm laundry room: washers and dryers drawn as lanes on a clock up to the deadline line; tap each friend's basket in the order it goes in, loads slide into the first free washer then the first free dryer, and the earliest finish where everything is dry before the line tops the board.
useWhen: laundry sunday at larkin, 6 loads 4 washers 2 dryers, can we all be done by 10
make a game out of the laundry room line
who can schedule our laundry fastest lol
will's comforter takes forever, puzzle it out
a quick puzzle for the group about sharing machines
dontUseWhen: tracking real machines that are running right now (use washer-watch)

a puzzle with words or trivia (use chat-crossword)

sub.description: Line under the title with the goal, e.g. 'everyone dry by 10 · tap bags in order'

opens.description: When the room opens, in minutes after noon (410 is 6:50pm)

due.description: When everything must be dry, in minutes after noon (600 is 10:00pm)

loads.description: One load per friend: owner name, what it is in their words, wash and dry minutes

board.description: Friends who already solved it: their name, the load order by owner name, and a short line
